title: Decadal Night Lights (2012–2023) — EIC Version
description: Visualizes annual average nighttime illumination from 2012 to 2023 and decadal change patterns (purple for increase, orange for decrease), derived from Suomi NPP VIIRS Black Marble observations.

source.citation: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio. (2024). Change in Night Lights between 2012 and 2023 — EIC Version (SVS 5313).
source.underlying_instrument: Suomi NPP / VIIRS (Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite)

phases.change_transition: Cross-fade into purple/orange decadal difference map

scientific_notice: Rendered video pixels represent cartographic estimates and visual classifications, not calibrated raw radiometric radiance.
